topic.title: Configure the Outline Pane Contextual Menu
topic.shortdesc: The contextual menu of the Outline pane can be configured per framework, in the webAuthorOutlineConfig.xml file, separately for the Contents and Structure modes.

section.title: Try it
section.p: Open the webinar-wa29.ditamap map and right-click an entry in the Outline pane.

ul.li: Contents mode (overrideBuiltInActions="no"): the configured entries (Change Title..., Insert Topic Reference... on topicref elements only, Edit Attributes...) are displayed first, followed by the built-in menu. An action that is also in the built-in menu is displayed only once.

Change Title... is a custom framework action. It sets the navigation title (navtitle) of the map entry, so the new title is displayed in the Outline right away. The title of the topic itself does not change.
Structure mode (no attribute, default "yes"): the configured entries replace the built-in menu.

section.title: The configuration file
section.p: user-frameworks/webinar-wa29-ditamap/outline/webAuthorOutlineConfig.xml, added to the classpath of a framework extension based on DITA Map:
section.codeblock: <outline> <structureMode editable="yes" default="no"> <preferredAttributes names="id keys"/> <menu> <action>App/FocusAttributesPanel</action> <sep/> <action>Author/CopySpecial</action> <sep/> <action>Outline/ExpandAll</action> <action>Outline/CollapseAll</action> </menu> </structureMode> <tocMode editable="yes" default="yes"> <elements names="topicref section topichead reltable chapter mapref"/> <!-- titleLocator elements omitted --> <menu overrideBuiltInActions="no"> <action>webinar.change.title</action> <action element="topicref">insert.topicref</action> <action>App/FocusAttributesPanel</action> <sep/> </menu> </tocMode> </outline>

section.title: The custom action
section.codeblock: <a:authorAction id="webinar.change.title" xmlns:a="http://www.oxygenxml.com/ns/author/external-action"> <a:name>Change Title...</a:name> <a:operations> <a:operation id="ChangeAttributeOperation"> <a:xpathCondition>self::*[contains(@class, ' map/topicref ')]</a:xpathCondition> <a:arguments> <a:argument name="elementLocation">.</a:argument> <a:argument name="name">navtitle</a:argument> <a:argument name="value">${ask('New title', generic, '')}</a:argument> </a:arguments> </a:operation> </a:operations> </a:authorAction>
